sql: with c as (select split_part(event_ticker,'-',1) as series, split_part(event_ticker,'-',2) as contest, close_time from mmsell_settlement_meta where close_time > now() - interval '30 days' and split_part(event_ticker,'-',2) <> ''), g as (select contest, count(*) markets, count(distinct series) series_n, count(distinct (close_time at time zone 'UTC')::date) utc_dates, min(split_part(series,'KX',2)) any_series from c group by 1) select case when utc_dates > 1 then 'STRADDLES' else 'single UTC date' end as bucket, count(*) contests, sum(markets) markets, sum(case when series_n > 1 then 1 else 0 end) multi_series_contests from g group by 1
